section.title: Community Support
section.p: pmMDA group provides community support, advices and development. All community activities are released under the Apache license and are available to all.
The error tracking system is the standard one provided in Sourceforge. The forums are available for questions and extension requests. The developers try to respond quickly to all pending demands.

section.title: Commercial Support
section.p: Commercial support is available for companies wishing extensive support, training and coaching activities. Commercial partners provide services in Europe.
Please send an email to the developers of pmMDA group at marcelbaumann@users.sourceforge.net

section.title: Sponsors
section.p: Companies are supporting the development of the pmMDA frameworks and the related projects.
